name: fstat
description: fstat() retrieves information about a file specified by a file descriptor and stores it in a stat structure. It is identical to stat(), but uses a file descriptor instead of a pathname. No permissions are required on the file itself, but execute permission is needed on directories if applicable.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the file to retrieve information about

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a stat structure where the file information is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
fd is not a valid open file descriptor
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory
File size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the appropriate types
